rationale: Predeclared engineering relative-error amplification bound of four for separating the two projected directions. No expert calibration, source-derived numeric coaching threshold, player identity, or desired score ordering is claimed. Nearly collinear directions cannot independently support a joint forward-and-down conclusion.
remaining_limitation: These remain fixed-camera 2D dot-product direction proxies, not orthogonalized components, world 3D travel, racket path, or force. General oblique-basis decomposition is not introduced in this change.
